svg.title: A terminal, and what it has been typing
svg.desc: 👋🏻 Hello World! / 🪞 Lint before a release / 🧹 Simplifying the boring parts / 🧭 Plain defaults over novelty / 🏷️ Every build carries a version / 📐 One way in with no side doors / 🚧 No step is copied twice / 🌱 No pipeline ages badly / 🧰 Tools I would make again / 🧮 Latency measured, not argued / ✂️ Cutting more than I write / ⛓️ A rule that cannot drift / 🗺️ Restored with one command
